title: My PC viewer simplified for one-hand control
summary: Match the connected desktop view to the requested phone experience with immersive screen space, large close control and a three-dot menu for advanced actions.

changes.detail: Replace the always-visible control surface with two large floating quick controls: close/disconnect and menu.
Keep the advanced keyboard, touch mode, zoom, settings and reconnect actions behind the three-dot menu while preserving direct touch gestures.
Hide transient status text after connection and keep the desktop viewport visually clear.
